protocol.name: zero-shot-agent-drop-json-answer
protocol.answer_format: JSON string or nonempty array of strings, with numeric answers encoded as strings
protocol.scorer: Unchanged AllenAI DROP evaluate_json; best EM and F1 over answer plus validated_answers
protocol.reward: official F1, rounded to two decimals per question by the upstream scorer
protocol.tools: chosen by target; tool-assisted agent protocol, not a fixed prompting or ADAS experiment
protocol.splits: Original train and dev labels retained as metadata; caller chooses evolve/test roles
protocol.empty_reference_rule: Nine released train records have no nonempty reference; preserved upstream scoring gives zero. Gold-transport oracle is unavailable for these IDs.
protocol.task_identity: split-query_id; repeated query IDs get a source-order -occurrence-N suffix. Every released record is preserved.

oracle.description: Copies a nonempty dataset answer to check transport and the official scorer, not an independently solved reference. Unavailable for the nine empty-reference train records.
